_comment: OpenRouter-backed config. The openrouter provider's api_key is injected from the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable (never commit a real key). The 'models' map translates the gateway's provider-tier names to real OpenRouter model ids. Mock alpha/beta are kept as fallbacks so a provider outage still yields a response. Use via: PRISM_GATEWAY_CONFIG_PATH=$(pwd)/gateway-config.openrouter.json OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-... ./gradlew bootRun
